events.name: EuroBLECH 2026
events.audience: Sheet metal processors, steel service centres, metal distributors
events.why: Core vertical: metal distribution and processing is where GeneralMind's reference customer Kloeckner Metals sits. PO confirmations, RFQs and order changes in this sector still run over email and PDF.
events.list_note: Exhibitors are machine vendors; buyers attend as visitors and are not published. Source via pre-show meeting booking and post-show account lists.

events.name: BVL Supply Chain CX 2026
events.audience: Supply chain and logistics decision makers, ~2,500 attendees
events.why: Germany's main supply chain congress, in GeneralMind's home city next week. Strong mix of shipper-side operations leaders.
events.list_note: Speakers and sponsors are public. Attendees are not; the BVL app matchmaker is the attendee channel.

events.name: European Manufacturing & Supply Chain Summit
events.audience: ~300 senior manufacturing, supply chain and procurement leaders
events.why: Small, senior, manufacturer-heavy room (Henkel, Bosch, Mondelez, AGRANA). Food & beverage presence matches the Oatly reference.
events.list_note: Featured speakers are public; full delegate list is sold by the organiser.

events.name: BME Symposium Einkauf & Logistik
events.audience: CPOs and procurement leaders from German industry
events.why: The procurement event in DACH, in Berlin. Procure-to-Pay (PO follow-up, 4-way match, AP) is half of GeneralMind's product and this room owns that budget.
events.list_note: Long public speaker list with titles; highest-yield source in this set.

events.name: Anuga FoodTec 2027
events.audience: Food and beverage producers: production, operations, supply chain
events.why: Core vertical: food & beverage (Oatly, bofrost* references). High order volumes, many customers, lots of email-driven order changes.
events.list_note: Speaker programme not published yet. Monitor from December; exhibitor list is mostly equipment vendors.

events.name: DSAG Technologietage 2027
events.audience: SAP customers: IT, architecture and process owners
events.why: GeneralMind writes into SAP and other ERPs. SAP process owners and S/4HANA programme leads are the technical buyers and the integration gatekeepers.
events.list_note: 2027 agenda not published; ticket sales opened 6 Oct 2026. Customer case-study speakers appear in the agenda ~8 weeks before.

events.name: LogiMAT 2027
events.why: Large logistics audience, but the published programme is vendor-heavy. Useful for partner mapping (SAP EWM/TM integrators) more than direct buyers.
events.list_note: 2026 programme analysed: speakers were almost all vendors, consultants or academics. Vendors are classified as partners, not leads.

events.name: HANNOVER MESSE 2027
events.why: Every German manufacturer is here. Too broad for blanket outreach; works as a meeting venue for already-qualified A-tier accounts.
events.list_note: 2027 speakers not published. 2026 Center Stage speakers were board-level (Siemens, Rheinmetall), far above the buying level.

events.name: transport logistic 2027
events.audience: ~64,000 visitors, ~2,500 exhibitors from logistics and supply chain
events.why: Freight and inbound/outbound logistics are named GeneralMind workflows. Shipper-side logistics heads from manufacturers and distributors attend.
events.list_note: Exhibitor registration still open; conference programme published early 2027.

events.name: Gartner Supply Chain Symposium/Xpo
events.audience: CSCOs and supply chain executives from Europe's largest enterprises
events.why: The most senior supply chain audience in Europe. Fits GeneralMind's enterprise motion and the 'AI that proves ROI' agenda Gartner pushes.
events.list_note: 2027 exhibitors and customer speakers 'to be announced'. Gartner does not publish attendee lists.
